queries.name: Example: results by test
queries.sql:
select coalesce(observation_desc, observation_code, '(unknown)') as test,
  count(*) as results
from lab_results
group by coalesce(observation_desc, observation_code, '(unknown)')
order by results desc

queries.name: Example: results in a period
queries.sql:
select coalesce(r.observation_desc, r.observation_code, '(unknown)') as test,
  count(*) as results
from lab_results r
join specimens s on s.id = r.specimen_id
where substring(s.received_time,1,10) >= {{param.from}}
  and substring(s.received_time,1,10) <= {{param.to}}
group by coalesce(r.observation_desc, r.observation_code, '(unknown)')
order by results desc
